hook: Content note: this article is about adults who stalk and abduct children, and its interview raises the question of pedophilia directly. The creatures hide in plain sight as large, ordinary-looking office workers, and most of the file is a calm anatomical breakdown of what is under the skin. The interview at the end is the real centerpiece, so take your time with it.
whyItMatters:
1788 is a predator-species entry that gets its horror from plausibility: no glowing eyes or tentacles, just people who blend into a city and quietly watch the local children. The Foundation's response is notably cold, extending termination orders even to the instances' own offspring, who are biologically ordinary humans.

It also uses a single interview to completely reframe everything the clinical sections described, which is a good illustration of how a late conversation can carry an entire article.
thingsToNotice:
The anatomy builds up one hidden layer at a time: metal-reinforced bones, a second heart, valves that seal off wounded limbs, a backup brain under its own ribcage, and finally a second pair of arms kept folded against the body. The footnote about a sniper blowing away most of an instance's head, main brain included, after which it still killed an agent, makes those backups feel concrete.

In the interview, 863 flies into a rage when asked if he is a pedophile, and then explains what the children really are to him. He insists his kind are fully human, with no implants, no scars and normal genes, and that ordinary adults are the stunted ones, unfinished like an amphibian that never leaves the water. The children he watches are eggs that need to hatch into his kind, and his final answer to what humanity should do is to grow up or die.
